name: settle5-jitter1
netlist:
simulator lang=spectre
ahdl_include "dut.va"
ahdl_include "device.va"
Xmeasure (ref clk relock_ns jitter_ns) dut
Xpll (ref clk) relock_device settle_cycles=5 jitter=1e-09
simulatorOptions options reltol=1e-6 vabstol=1e-9
tran tran stop=4.5u maxstep=0.5n
saveOptions options save=allpub
